summary: Starry Sea Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-domiciled SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K reporting postponement of its extraordinary general meeting from October 9 to October 19, 2026 to allow more time to engage shareholders. Redemption tabulation as of the October 7 deadline shows 4,281,993 public shares submitted for redemption, leaving 1,468,007 outstanding; the company seeks reversals on roughly 350,174 shares to reach at least 1,818,181. At that level monthly extension contributions are about $59,999.97, or $0.033 per share, within the $60,000 cap. Watch reversal success and extension-vote outcomes.
